menu.title: SHERPAS AT THE LIMIT
menu.subtitle: Two sherpas, a rich man on his plank, and Everest.

hud.summitSub: The rich man wants a selfie. You want your pay.

hud.howToSub: PRESS a hand or foot and DRAG it: nearby holds magnetize it (green ring) and it sticks on release, if you reach. Climb BOTH at the same height: if one rushes ahead the plank tilts and the rich man slips · H = help

keys.p1: MOUSE: press a limb and drag it onto a hold (green ring) · release to fix it · F: superpower
keys.p2: P2: Arrows aim · I/O hands · K/L feet · U shoo · or gamepad: stick + A/B/X/Y + RB · P: superpower
keys.shared: Space pause · H help · C recenter · F3 debug

help.title: How to play
help.goal: Goal: the TWO sherpas climb Everest carrying the rich man SITTING on a plank hung by a rope on each side. Reach the summit (5301 m) together.
help.step1: 1) GRAB: click a hand or foot of either sherpa (orange or blue) and hold. The limb is now yours and lets go of its hold.
help.step2: 2) DRAG: move the pointer across the wall. Nearby holds act like MAGNETS: a green ring appears when a hold can capture the limb. Only holds you can reach will catch it.
help.step3: 3) CLIMB: release the click over the hold and the limb flies to it. Alternate feet and hands (feet first, then hands) and never let go of all 4 at once or you will fall.
help.step4: 4) COORDINATE: one rope goes from each side of the plank to each sherpa. If one climbs higher than the other, the plank TILTS, shifts and the rich man SLIPS towards the abyss: climb at the same height, step by step.
help.extra: R shoo birds · Space pause · C recenter camera · H opens/closes this help.
